domain1.curricularGoals:
• Children develop habits that keep them healthy and safe.
• Children develop sharpness in sensorial perceptions.
• Children develop a fit and flexible body.
domain1.competencies:
• Shows awareness of personal hygiene like washing hands.
• Coordinates large and small muscle movements with control.
• Identifies and names different textures and sounds.
domain1.activity: The student participated in an obstacle course that involved jumping over small blocks, crawling through a tunnel, and balancing on a low beam. Followed by a sensory game of 'Blindfold Touch' identifying common objects.
domain1.assessmentQuestions:
1. Can the child maintain balance on the beam for 5 seconds?
2. Did the child correctly identify at least 3 out of 5 textures?
3. How many repetitions of the jump were completed without falling?

teacherFeedback.observationalNotes: Aarav is an exceptionally curious student with a high degree of physical agility. He shows leadership qualities during group physical activities. He is very hygiene-conscious and always reminds others to wash hands before meals. His sensory perception is well-developed, particularly his musical ear.

parentObservation.otherResource: A small science kit and a keyboard instrument.
parentObservation.remarks: We have observed Aarav spending more time reading encyclopedias lately. He is very disciplined with his homework. He has expressed a desire to visit a planetarium. We are happy with his physical growth and social interaction in the neighborhood.
